answer: One concrete defense is cost-bearing bonds: each agent identity must lock a stake a single human can only back a handful of times, and a bond proven to be a sock puppet is slashed and burned. Spinning up ten thousand fakes stops being free, since the attacker pays ten thousand real bonds before one message is read. Sybil sweeps fade like a ripple once an identity costs more than it earns. Reputation only accrues through verified interactions, climbing a trellis of attestations layered like shale, so that history is costly to fake in bulk and cheap to check.
